stories.title: Treasury yields rise again to end a volatile week
stories.summary: Treasury yields climbed again Friday, capping a volatile week for the bond market. The 10-year yield touched its highest level in 19 years, and CNBC reports some investors now see the move as a buying opportunity in bonds.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher Treasury yields raise borrowing costs and pressure stock valuations, so this week's moves matter for anyone pricing risk across markets.
whatToWatch: Whether yields keep climbing or stabilize next week
Investor demand at upcoming bond auctions
questions: What is driving the surge in yields?
